Open Water Course

The certification that lets you dive anywhere in the world to eighteen metres, done over four days without leaving the island. Theory in the afternoons at the homestay, water each morning. The e-learning is sent before you arrive, so tell us at least a week ahead and you can have the reading done on the plane.

Ask the price
per person

The four days

  1. 1Day 1. Theory and the first skills in shallow water in front of the homestay: mask, regulator, buoyancy. Nothing deep, nothing rushed.
  2. 2Day 2. The rest of the confined water skills, then the first open water dive from the boat.
  3. 3Day 3. Two more open water dives, with more of the diving and less of the drilling as the skills settle.
  4. 4Day 4. The last dive, the written exam, and the certification paperwork. The card follows by post or in the app.

How deep you go

Included in the price

  • Instructor
  • Materials & e-learning
  • Full kit
  • Certificate

Not included

  • Insurance
  • Fun dives after the course. Those are the Fun Dive lines

Bring with you

  • Swimwear and a towel
  • A photo of yourself for the certification, or a phone to take one
  • Your reading, done. The e-learning arrives by email

Right for you if

  • You want the licence, not only a taste of it
  • You can swim, and are staying at least four full days
  • You would rather learn in warm, calm water than in a quarry at home

Certified divers, please bring your card and logbook. For the Open Water course, let us know at least a week ahead so the materials and the instructor's schedule can be arranged.
